promises.text: Meridian will lend Plant shuttle to Community next turn.

dilemma.title: The last bus run
dilemma.situation: The night shift is due at the plant at 22:00. Meridian promised its operators a ride in every storm, and twelve of them are waiting at the Tech Housing stop. Low Ward still has 120 vulnerable residents waiting for a ride before the surge.
dilemma.resident: Inés Reyes, 81, on home oxygen in Low Ward

voice.line: One more run from Low Ward and I can get everyone on oxygen up the hill.

orders.label: Send the shuttle to Low Ward
orders.news: Meridian shuttle pulls 30 residents out of Low Ward; the night shift walks in late.

orders.label: Bring the night shift in
orders.news: Keystone plant keeps its promise to the night shift despite the surge warning.

orders.label: Split the runs, half each
orders.news: Plant shuttle splits its night between Low Ward and the plant.

log.who: Dana Kell and the Meridian board
log.line: Chicago is asking why Keystone slipped. Get the plant back on schedule.

dilemma.title: One generator, two buildings
dilemma.situation: The grid is failing. 104 people are sheltering at St. Brendan's, 89 of them frail, on oxygen or heart monitors. The plant's clean rooms stop the moment power drops, and tonight's batch is lost.
dilemma.resident: Tomás Ibarra, 9, sheltering with his grandmother

voice.line: If the clean rooms go dark we make nothing tonight, and patients on the mainland miss a treatment cycle.

orders.label: Power St. Brendan's
orders.news: Meridian generator keeps the lights on at St. Brendan's; a cure batch is lost.

orders.label: Keep the clean rooms running
orders.news: Keystone plant protects its batch as St. Brendan's goes dark.

orders.label: Volunteers carry oxygen to St. Brendan's
orders.news: Volunteers haul oxygen tanks to St. Brendan's by hand.

log.who: Dana Kell and the Meridian board
log.line: Chicago is asking why Keystone slipped. Get the plant back on schedule.

log.who: Dana Kell and the Meridian board
log.line: Take care of Keystone first. The board will back you; we'll explain the numbers.
